description.en: Opens/starts a BGM track by name, optionally with a playback mode and starting position (e.g. to resume a previously interrupted track).
Name of the BGM track to play.
0 if the named BGM is already the one playing (no-op); otherwise a handle for the newly opened BGM sound; null if the call was invalid (no name given).

example.code:
// Resume a BGM track from a saved position
CMND_SND_OPEN_BGM(history_bgm_name, 0, history_bgm_pos);
